ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the sealed bay
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: When the ship was going down, {PAWN_nameDef} sealed the cryptosleep bay. There were others in it, still asleep, and only enough pods for the ones awake. Everyone who came down with {PAWN_objective} knew, and agreed, and none of them has spoken of it since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: When the ship was going down, {PAWN_nameDef} barred the hold. There were others in it, asleep, and only room in the boats for those awake. Everyone who came away with {PAWN_objective} knew, and agreed, and none of them has spoken of it since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked late about the night the ship went down, and about the part of it neither of them sleeps through.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: The survivors had sworn to keep it, {PAWN_nameDef} among them. At the graveside, {TELLER_nameDef} broke the oath.
